        if val > 0 then
            if j == 0 then
                if val <= 10 then
                    res = res .. first10[val]
                else
                    res = res .. getStandardDigitStr(val)
                end
            else
                if val == 1 then
                    res = res .. getBlockSuffix(j, false)
                else
                    res = res .. getStandardDigitStr(val) .. getBlockSuffix(j, true)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return res
end

    local dict = {}
    for i = 0, 255 do dict[string.char(i)] = i end

    local w = ""
